definition_zh: 复杂性；复杂程度；（计算）复杂度；错综复杂的事物；复杂性科学
definition_en: the state of having many interconnected parts or aspects; the degree to which something is hard to understand or analyse
core_image: 一张网越织越密，每根线都搭在别的线上，抽动一根，整张网都动
scene: 这个问题的难处不在参数多，而在参数彼此牵连，改一个就牵动全部。The real complexity of the problem is not the number of parameters but the way each one pulls on all the others.
sceneCN: 这里 complexity 是「复杂性、错综关联的程度」（第 1 个义项：由许多相互关联的部分构成的状态）；句意：这个问题的真正复杂性不在参数多，而在参数彼此牵连。图中可辨识物件：密集的网、相互连接的节点、参数面板、放大的线结、演算纸。

pos.zh: 复杂性；复杂程度；复杂度

senses.title: Many interconnected parts
senses.definition: the state of consisting of many parts that affect one another
senses.definitionCN: 由许多相互影响的部分构成的状态
senses.example: The complexity of the ecosystem defies simple models.
senses.exampleCN: 该生态系统的复杂性使简单模型失效。
senses.why: This is the core sense: not merely 'many', but 'many and linked'. A pile of sand has many grains but low complexity; a web has fewer threads but high complexity because each pull travels.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心义：不只是“多”，而是“多且相互关联”。一堆沙粒很多却复杂度低；一张网线更少却复杂度高，因为每次拉动都会传导。

senses.title: Computational complexity
senses.definition: the amount of time or memory an algorithm needs as input size grows
senses.definitionCN: 算法随输入规模增长所需的时间或内存量
senses.example: Sorting has a complexity of n log n.
senses.exampleCN: 排序的复杂度为 n log n。
senses.why: Computer science makes complexity a measurable quantity. It is not about how hard the code looks but about how resource use scales, which turns an intuition into a curve.
senses.whyCN: 计算机科学使复杂性成为可测量。它不是看代码多难懂，而是看资源用量如何随规模增长，把直觉变成曲线。

senses.title: A level of complexity
senses.definition: the degree to which something is complex, often compared across cases
senses.definitionCN: 某物复杂的程度，常用于跨案例比较
senses.example: The tasks were ranked by complexity.
senses.exampleCN: 这些任务按复杂程度排序。
senses.why: The noun can be countable here: one complexity, a higher complexity. This lets researchers compare systems on a scale, even though the scale itself must be defined.
senses.whyCN: 此处名词可数：一种复杂度、更高的复杂度。这使研究者能在尺度上比较系统，尽管尺度本身须被定义。

senses.title: Intricacy of plot or structure
senses.definition: the quality of a story or structure with many intertwined threads
senses.definitionCN: 故事或结构有多条交织线索的性质
senses.example: the complexity of the novel's timeline
senses.exampleCN: 小说时间线的错综复杂
senses.why: Literary criticism uses the word for designed intricacy. Unlike confusion, complexity can be a value: the reader is trusted to hold several threads at once.
senses.whyCN: 文学批评用该词指有意设计的错综。与混乱不同，复杂性可以是一种价值：读者被信任能同时握住多条线。

senses.title: Complexity science
senses.definition: the study of systems whose collective behaviour emerges from many interacting parts
senses.definitionCN: 研究由许多相互作用部分涌现出集体行为的系统
senses.example: Complexity science studies markets, cells, and cities.
senses.exampleCN: 复杂性科学研究市场、细胞与城市。
senses.why: This is an institutional sense: a field named after its object. It treats emergence, feedback, and adaptation as shared features across very different systems.
senses.whyCN: 这是制度义：以对象命名的领域。它把涌现、反馈与适应当作跨非常不同系统的共同特征。

senses.title: A complicated thing
senses.definition: a particular thing, situation, or detail that is hard to handle
senses.definitionCN: 难以处理的特定事物、情形或细节
senses.example: We must deal with several complexities first.
senses.exampleCN: 我们得先处理若干复杂问题。
senses.why: The countable plural turns the abstract quality into obstacles. In project talk, 'the complexities' are the specific snags that must be listed, priced, and solved.
senses.whyCN: 可数复数把抽象性质变成障碍。在项目话语中，the complexities 是必须列出、计价并解决的具体麻烦。

senses.title: Biological complexity
senses.definition: the layered organization of living systems from molecules to ecosystems
senses.definitionCN: 生命系统从分子到生态的多层组织
senses.example: Cellular complexity arose early in evolution.
senses.exampleCN: 细胞复杂性在演化早期就出现了。
senses.why: Biology uses the word for levels of organization and their integration. The puzzle is how simple components produce hierarchical order without a central designer.
senses.whyCN: 生物学用该词指组织层级及其整合。谜题是简单组分如何在没有中心设计者的情况下产生层级秩序。

senses.title: Algorithmic time complexity
senses.definition: the growth rate of an algorithm's running time with input size
senses.definitionCN: 算法运行时间随输入规模增长的速率
senses.example: This search has linear time complexity.
senses.exampleCN: 该搜索具有线性时间复杂度。
senses.why: This narrow sense names a class of functions, not a feeling. Complexity here is a property of a procedure, and 'high complexity' can be a technical defect even in a fast program.
senses.whyCN: 这一窄义命名一类函数，而非感觉。此处复杂性是程序的属性，“高复杂度”即使在快程序中也可以是技术缺陷。

senses.title: Social complexity
senses.definition: the density of roles, rules, and interactions in a society or organization
senses.definitionCN: 社会或组织中角色、规则与互动的密度
senses.example: Urban life brings social complexity.
senses.exampleCN: 城市生活带来社会复杂性。
senses.why: Social science uses the word for differentiated roles and institutions. More complexity can mean more capacity, but also more points of failure and more unequal access to understanding.
senses.whyCN: 社会科学用该词指分化的角色与制度。更高的复杂性可意味着更强能力，也意味着更多故障点与更不平等的理解通道。

intro.en: Complexity is complex plus -ity. Complex comes from Latin complexus, the past participle of complecti 'to encircle, embrace', from com- 'together' plus plectere 'to weave, braid'. The image is strands woven into one fabric, not parts merely piled up. The -ity noun follows Latin -itas. Note the near-twin complicated: it comes from complicare, com- plus plicare 'to fold', a different though related root. Complex says 'woven together'; complicated says 'folded together'.
intro.cn: complexity 是 complex 加 -ity。complex 出自拉丁 complexus，即 complecti“环绕、拥抱”的过去分词，由 com-“一起”加 plectere“编织、编辫”构成。意象是多股线织成一块布，而非零件堆放。名词 -ity 依拉丁 -itas。注意近形词 complicated：它出自 complicare，com- 加 plicare“折叠”，词根不同但相关。complex 说“织在一起”；complicated 说“折在一起”。

items.en: plectere means 'to weave, braid, intertwine'; it gives the 'plex' seen in complex and perplex.
items.cn: plectere 意为“编织、编辫、缠绕”，给出 complex、perplex 中的 -plex。

items.en: complecti is com- 'together' plus plectere: to embrace or encircle, literally to weave together.
items.cn: complecti 是 com-“一起”加 plectere：拥抱、环绕，字面即“织在一起”。

items.en: complexus, its past participle, means 'interwoven, encircling'; English complex keeps the sense of many parts joined.
items.cn: 其过去分词 complexus 意为“交织的、环绕的”；英语 complex 保留“多部分相连”义。

items.en: English complexity appears in the 17C for the state of being complex, first in learned prose.
items.cn: 英语 complexity 于十七世纪出现，指复杂的状态，最早用于学术散文。

items.en: Mathematics and computer science make 'complexity' a measurable growth rate for algorithms.
items.cn: 二十世纪数学与计算机科学把 complexity 变成算法可测量的增长率。

items.en: Complexity science turns the noun into a field name for systems with emergent collective behaviour.
items.cn: 复杂性科学把该名词变成领域名称，指具有涌现集体行为的系统。

note.en: The first group is the complex family and its look-alike relatives; the second is words for difficulty, which differ in whether they name many parts, tangled folds, or mere difficulty.
note.cn: 第一组是 complex 词族及其近形亲属；第二组是“难”类词，差别在于指多部分、乱折叠还是单纯困难。

entries.definition: woven from many interconnected parts; also a group of linked buildings or symptoms.
entries.definitionCN: 由许多相互关联部分织成的；也指建筑群或症状群。

entries.definition: the natural colour and texture of the skin; also the general character of something.
entries.definitionCN: 肤色与质地；也指某物的总体性质。

entries.definition: to confuse by complexity, literally to weave thoroughly.
entries.definitionCN: 因复杂而使人困惑，字面即“织得密不透风”。

entries.definition: a difficulty that makes a situation harder; literally a folding together. It is a separate root from complex.
entries.definitionCN: 使情形更难的因素；字面即“折在一起”。与 complex 词根不同。

entries.definition: the quality of having many fine, entangled details. It stresses fine structure rather than scale.
entries.definitionCN: 有许多细密缠结细节的性质。强调细结构，而非规模。

entries.definition: the quality of being hard to do or understand. It names resistance, not structure.
entries.definitionCN: 难以做成或理解的性质。命名阻力，而非结构。

normalIntro.en: Real links: plectere 'weave', complexus 'woven together', the -ity noun, and the contrast with complicare 'fold together'.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：plectere“编织”、complexus“织在一起”、-ity 名词，以及与 complicare“折在一起”的对照。

normal.en: Complex is 'woven together', from plectere 'weave'. The parts are threads, and the pattern is the point.
normal.cn: complex 是“织在一起”，出自 plectere“编织”。部分是线，图案才是关键。

normal.en: Complicated is 'folded together', from plicare 'fold'. Folded paper is tangled; woven cloth is structured. The twins are not the same.
normal.cn: complicated 是“折在一起”，出自 plicare“折叠”。折纸是乱缠；织布是有结构。这对双胞胎并不相同。

normal.en: Complexity is not the count of parts but the density of their connections.
normal.cn: 复杂性不是部分的数量，而是连接密度。

normal.en: In algorithms, complexity is a growth curve, not a mood; n log n is a different claim from 'hard'.
normal.cn: 算法中，复杂度是增长曲线，不是情绪；n log n 与“难”是不同主张。

normal.en: 'The complexities' are the specific snags a project must price; the abstract noun becomes a checklist.
normal.cn: the complexities 是项目必须计价的具体麻烦；抽象名词变成清单。

abstract.en: Complexity is relational: it belongs to the pattern of dependence, not to any single part.
abstract.cn: 复杂性是关系性的：它属于依赖模式，而不属于任何单个部分。

abstract.en: A system can be complex and still predictable, or simple and chaotic; complexity is structure, not uncertainty.
abstract.cn: 系统可以复杂却可预测，也可以简单却混沌；复杂性是结构，不是不确定性。

abstract.en: Naming something complex is often a claim about who is entitled to understand it.
abstract.cn: 把某物称为复杂，常是关于“谁有资格理解它”的主张。

examples.en: The complexity of the tax code is a burden on small firms.
examples.cn: 税法的复杂性是小企业的负担。

examples.en: This algorithm has quadratic time complexity.
examples.cn: 该算法具有平方时间复杂度。

examples.en: The novel's complexity rewards a second reading.
examples.cn: 这部小说的复杂性值得再读一遍。

dict_mnemonic.text: “康普莱克西提”——许多线 com 在一起织成 plex → complexity 复杂性

root: complex（拉丁 complexus ← complecti“环绕、织在一起”= com-“一起”+ plectere“编织”）+ -ity；近形词 complicated 出自 complicare（plicare“折叠”），词根不同。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of complexity: interconnected parts, computational cost, a degree, narrative intricacy, a science, a specific snag, biological organization, algorithmic growth, and social density. All turn on how parts are related, not how many there are.
sensesIntro.cn: complexity 的九个义项：相互关联的部分、计算代价、程度、叙事错综、一门科学、具体麻烦、生物组织、算法增长、社会密度。关键都在部分如何关联，而非数量多少。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a net so densely woven that pulling one thread moves the whole web.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张织得极密的网，抽动一根线，整张网都动。

branches.en: THE PATTERN: ecosystems, plots, and cells are woven structures whose order is the object.
branches.cn: 图案：生态系统、情节与细胞都是织成结构，其秩序才是对象。

branches.en: THE COST: computing turns complexity into a growth rate of time or memory.
branches.cn: 代价：计算把复杂性变成时间或内存的增长率。

branches.en: THE DEGREE AND THE SNAG: one can rank complexity and list its concrete troubles.
branches.cn: 程度与麻烦：既可给复杂性排序，也可列出其具体麻烦。

branches.en: THE FIELD: complexity science studies emergence across markets, cells, and cities.
branches.cn: 领域：复杂性科学研究市场、细胞与城市中的涌现。

branches.en: THE SOCIETY: roles and rules multiply, adding capacity and fragility at once.
branches.cn: 社会：角色与规则增殖，同时增加能力与脆弱。

intro.en: Complexity is complex + -ity. Complex is Latin complexus, from complecti, com- plus plectere 'weave'. The family includes complexify and complexification; the same root gives complexion and perplex, while the look-alike complicated comes from plicare 'fold'.
intro.cn: complexity 是 complex 加 -ity。complex 是拉丁 complexus，出自 complecti（com- 加 plectere“编织”）。词族含 complexify 与 complexification；同根给出 complexion 与 perplex，而近形词 complicated 出自 plicare“折叠”。

latinIntro.en: Latin plectere 'weave' gives complecti 'embrace, weave together' and its participle complexus. English builds complex, complexity, and complexify on this stem. The parallel root plicare 'fold' gives complicate and complication, which is why the two English adjectives feel alike but are not cognate twins.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 plectere“编织”给出 complecti“拥抱、织在一起”及其分词 complexus。英语在此词干上造 complex、complexity、complexify。平行词根 plicare“折叠”给出 complicate 与 complication，故两个英语形容词感觉相近却并非同源双生。

items.meaningCN: 复杂的；综合体（形容词/名词）

items.meaning: a network of nerves or vessels

definition_zh: 使复杂化；使难懂；使恶化
definition_en: to make something more difficult to understand or deal with
core_image: 本来一条笔直的线，被不断打结，越绕越乱
scene: 本来只是一件小事，他一解释反而添了乱。Do not complicate a simple apology with long excuses.
sceneCN: 这里 complicate 指「使复杂化」（第 1 个义项：让事情变得更难处理）；句意是别用冗长的借口把一句简单的道歉弄复杂。

pos.zh: 使复杂化；使难懂；使恶化

senses.title: Make harder to follow
senses.definition: to make something harder to understand by adding parts
senses.definitionCN: 通过增加内容让某事更难理解
senses.example: Extra rules only complicate the game.
senses.exampleCN: 多余的规则只会让游戏变复杂。
senses.why: Every added part becomes one more thing the mind must hold.
senses.whyCN: 每增加一部分，脑子就要多记住一样东西。

senses.title: Make a problem worse
senses.definition: to make a bad situation or illness more serious
senses.definitionCN: 使糟糕的处境或病情变得更严重
senses.example: Stress can complicate recovery from illness.
senses.exampleCN: 压力会让病后恢复变得更棘手。
senses.why: A second trouble arriving on top of the first multiplies the burden.
senses.whyCN: 第二个麻烦压在第一个之上，负担就成倍增加。

senses.title: Twist things together
senses.definition: to fold or twist things together so they are hard to separate
senses.definitionCN: 把东西折叠或缠绕在一起，难以分开
senses.example: The wires were complicated into a tight knot.
senses.exampleCN: 电线被缠成了一个紧结。
senses.why: The oldest sense is physical folding, and confusion is folding in the mind.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思是物理上的折叠，而困惑就是脑子里的折叠。

intro.en: Complicate comes from Latin complicare, to fold together, and first described things twisted into one another.
intro.cn: complicate 来自拉丁语 complicare，意为折在一起，最初描述互相缠结的东西。

items.en: Com- meant together and plicare meant to fold.
items.cn: com- 表示一起，plicare 表示折叠。

items.en: Complicare described folding several layers into one bundle.
items.cn: complicare 描述把好几层折成一捆。

items.en: Old French compliquer carried the idea into everyday speech.
items.cn: 古法语 compliquer 把这个意思带入日常语言。

items.en: English complicate first meant to intertwine or entangle.
items.cn: 英语 complicate 最初指使交织、使缠结。

items.en: It now means to make a matter harder to understand or to handle.
items.cn: 如今它指让事情更难理解或更难处理。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words that share the shape of complicate, and the meaning group names other ways of making a matter hard.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 complicate 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他把事弄难的说法。

entries.definition: a problem that makes a situation worse
hard to understand or deal with
to make someone unable to think clearly
to twist things together so they are hard to separate
to make something confusing or disordered

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with folded cloth, then move to tangled wires and to problems that grow heavier.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从折起的布开始，再走到缠住的电线与越压越重的问题。

normal.en: Com- is together and plic- is fold, so to complicate is to fold things into each other.
normal.cn: com- 是一起，plic- 是折叠，所以 complicate 就是把东西折到一起。

normal.en: A simple task plus one extra rule equals a complicated task.
normal.cn: 简单的任务加一条多余的规则，就变成复杂的任务。

normal.en: A knot is complicate made visible in a piece of string.
normal.cn: 一个结，就是 complicate 在一根绳子上的可见形态。

normal.en: When an illness is complicated, a second problem has joined the first.
normal.cn: 病情被 complicate 时，就是第二个问题加入了第一个。

normal.en: Keep the promise simple and you never need to complicate it.
normal.cn: 把承诺保持简单，就永远不必把它弄复杂。

abstract.en: Picture one straight road that keeps splitting into smaller paths.
abstract.cn: 想象一条直路不断分出更小的岔路。

abstract.en: Picture a ball of string pulled by two hands at once.
abstract.cn: 想象一团线被两只手同时拉扯。

abstract.en: Picture a short answer buried under pages of notes.
abstract.cn: 想象一个简短答案被成页的注释埋住。

examples.en: The new rules only complicate the process for everyone.
examples.cn: 新规则只是让每个人的流程都变复杂。

branches.cn: 形容词用法只是标注某部分属于整体。

branches.en: Hardware and ideas are both assembled from smaller pieces.
branches.cn: 硬件和理念都由更小的部分组装而成。

branches.en: Component parts is the same idea used as a description.
branches.cn: component parts 只是把同一个意思用作描述。

intro.en: Component is built on Latin com-, together, plus ponere, to put, with the ending -ent.
intro.cn: component 由拉丁语 com-（一起）、ponere（放置）与词尾 -ent 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base pon- also gives compose, position and deposit.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基 pon- 还给出 compose、position 与 deposit 这些词。

items.exampleCN: 这套工具包含五十个部件。
这家工厂供应电子零部件。

items.example: The study uses a componential analysis.
items.exampleCN: 这项研究采用成分分析法。
这两个系统在成分上有所不同。
十名成员组成这个委员会。

items.meaning: the way parts are put together
items.example: The composition of the soil matters.
The bridge uses a composite material.
items.exampleCN: 这座桥使用一种复合材料。
